pages.text: $(bold)Sonar System$()$(br2)Store a sonar in your transformed ship core's enhancement slots and it works automatically — it applies a brief glow to nearby non-player living targets every 40 ticks so you can spot them by eye.$(br2)Three tiers with spherical radius: Standard 24 blocks, Improved 32, Advanced 40. Range is capped by server simulation distance.

$(bold)Notes$()$(br2)The sonar marks all aquatic and living non-player creatures — it does not distinguish friend from foe, and does not mark players.$(br2)Best paired with torpedoes and depth charges: confirm the underwater contact first, then fire or close in to drop charges.
